name: Corn Soup with Chicken, Bell Pepper, Avocado & Chili-Garlic Yogurt

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large pot over medium-high heat.

While the pot heats up, pat the chicken dry with paper towels. Holding a knife parallel to the cutting board, cut the chicken in half horizontally to form thin fillets. Season both sides with salt and pepper.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless
½ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add chicken and cook, flipping once, until golden brown and cooked through, 7-8 minutes. Remove to a plate and set aside.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 green bell peppers
2 jalapeño peppers
1 lime
1 small bunch green onions (scallions)
2 avocados

instructions.primary_message: Using a clean cutting board, peel and small dice onion; peel and mince garlic. Place both in a medium bowl.
Trim, seed, and small dice bell peppers. Add to the bowl with the onion and garlic.

Quarter jalapeño peppers lengthwise; seed and remove ribs with a spoon. Mince and add to the bowl. (Be careful with jalapeños; do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)

Return the pot (with cooking juices) to medium heat, add more oil, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add the onion, garlic, bell pepper, and jalapeño to the pot; cook, stirring often, until veggies soften, 4-5 minutes. (Reserve bowl for the next step.)
While the veggies cook, juice lime into the reserved bowl. Add yogurt, chili-garlic sauce, salt, and pepper; whisk to combine the yogurt sauce and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅔ cup plain Greek yogurt
2 tsp chili-garlic sauce
1 tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Trim green onions and cut crosswise into ¼-inch pieces.
Halve and pit the avocados; slice crosswise while still in the skin and scoop out with a spoon.
Add broth, corn, salt, and pepper to the pot. Cover and bring to a boil; once boiling, reduce heat and let simmer for 5 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
48 fl oz (6 cups) chicken or vegetable broth
4 cups frozen corn
2 tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, using two forks, shred the chicken into bite-sized pieces.

Transfer half the soup to a blender and purée until smooth. Return puréed soup to the pot, add the shredded chicken, and stir to combine. (Alternatively, use a hand blender to partially blend the soup directly in the pan.) Continue to cook, stirring often, until warmed through, 1-2 minutes.
To serve, divide soup between bowls. Top each bowl with yogurt sauce, green onions, and avocado. Enjoy!
